title: Failure Pattern Studio: grouped retries & payload snapshots
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem statement: Engineering and SRE teams complain that the current Console debugging flows surface noisy, duplicated retry rows and make it difficult to identify the true failure pattern across retries, model fallbacks, and partial timeouts. Designers must propose an integrated studio that groups related attempts, surfaces compact payload snapshots and diffs, and ties errors to an evidence-weighted taxonomy so triage is faster and less error-prone.

Scope: prototype a Failure Pattern Studio module in the Redwood Console that can be opened from a failed-request row or a session trace. The module should: (1) automatically cluster related attempts (retries, fallbacks, region switches), (2) show payload snapshots with ability to diff key fields across attempts, (3) expose an evidence-backed error taxonomy with confidence scores and links to logs/stackframes, and (4) provide quick actions (replay with altered prompt, pin payload snapshot, create rollout rule).

Non-goals: this ticket does not implement backend clustering or KV-cache instrumentation; assume a mocked clustering API for the prototype. We are not changing billing/usage counters in this design.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype shows grouped attempt lanes for a selected failure session
Payload snapshot viewer loads first three attempt payloads and supports side-by-side diffs for top-level keys
Taxonomy panel presents 3 inferred root causes with confidence percentages and links to logs/stackframes
Quick action bar supports: Replay with modifications, Pin snapshot to issue, and Create canary rollout rule
Design passes cross-functional review with Engineering and Product and actionable notes captured
